Alger, 9 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 9, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Mobilis is launching "MU Champions", a national contest rewarding its Revolution plan subscribers with prizes of up to one million dinars or smartphones. The concept is based on the consumption and accumulation of units (MU) over a weekly period with no set end date.
L’opérateur Mobilis a lancé le 8 novembr: On November 8, operator Mobilis launched the "MU Champions" challenge, aimed at rewarding the loyalty and activity of its customers on its Revolution offer. This program, with no announced end date, distinguishes two categories of participants: the top unit (MU) consumers and the top accumulators, with various prizes every week.
Les MU, unités utilisables pour les appe: MUs, units usable for calls, SMS, and internet browsing, serve as the basis for the ranking. Each week, twelve subscribers are named winners: six in each category. The top consumer winners take home cash prizes of up to one million dinars (100 million centimes), while the top accumulators win a smartphone valued at 350,000 dinars (35 million centimes). Results are announced every Thursday on Mobilis's official channels.
Le barème de calcul des unités est simpl: The unit calculation scale is simple: 5 MU per minute of calls, 10 MU per SMS, and 50 MU per gigabyte of internet. A subscriber consuming 10 GB in a week thus accumulates 500 MU, giving them a significant advantage in the accumulator category.
Le challenge vise à récompenser deux pro: The challenge aims to reward two distinct profiles: heavy consumers (calls, SMS, data-intensive) and accumulation strategists, with prizes tailored to each category.
